setting.help: A 3-letter code prepended to the Lead and Opportunity sequence numbers for this company (e.g. ABC-L/00001, ABC-O/00001). Leave empty to use the default L/ and O/ prefixes. Changing it does not reset the running number.

On: every salesperson in this company sees leads that have no salesperson yet (stock Odoo behaviour). Off: only the team leader of the lead's team, sales managers, directors, operations, and lead administrators see them. Takes effect immediately, per company.
Which group must approve each deal phase (EOI/Reservation/Contract) x role (Manager/Financial/Sales/Operations). Configurable per client, instead of a fixed hardcoded matrix.
The pre-qualification stages a lead moves through before becoming a qualified opportunity (New, No Answer, Call Later, Follow Up, Qualified, Unqualified, Locked).
The job-level roles (Salesperson/Team Leader/Sales Manager/Director/Operations) used to compute the commission hierarchy on a deal.

Enable or disable individual optional features -- portal pages (units, permission requests, ...) and commission behaviours (segmentation, retroactive effect, team rollup) -- without uninstalling the module that provides them.
